text.tspan: Monthly surface temperature anomalies by decadeWorld
Average decadal difference between a month's average surface temperature from the mean temperature of the
same month during the period 1991-2020, in degrees Celsius.
Data source: Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (2026)
Note: The numbers 1 to 12 on the horizontal axis represent the months of the year, from 1 for January to 12 for December. Note that the
decadal average for 2020, comprising fewer than the typical 10 data points, may introduce greater uncertainty compared to other decades.
